evidence.observation: Ordinary Return is passed into the literal inline replacement route. The UITextView overrides specialize marked-text composition only. No native keyboard structural dispatch exists in this complete file.
The mounted presentation has a per-block text draft and independent block creation, but no split or merge mutation entry.

The exact Host editor API applies one existing-block conditional PATCH with document version and engine-run conditions, then verifies readback and an inverse. It cannot atomically create/delete a second block.
The independent current-writer block POST has its own creation journal and uncertain-result handling. Combining it with a text PATCH is not an atomic structural operation.
Heart already dispatches original setAndSplit and merge operations. This finding does not remove, replace or reimplement those paths.

requiredCapabilityBoundary.owner: Wave1 Native/Host capability coordinated by root; Wave2 downstream input/presentation only after a reviewed supported operation exists
operations: Atomic split: replace one selected display range with a block boundary while retaining prefix/suffix native inline content, anchor identity fragments and all unrelated fields.
Atomic merge: join the exact current adjacent blocks, preserve semantic fragments/formatting and valid children/order, and retire the consumed block in one native change.
conditions: Exact account, Space, object, native dataset, engine-run and current version/read authority; current write permission at dispatch.
Explicit source block identities and topology, exact original native content, Unicode-valid range and unambiguous ordering.
Native-generated or prepared creation identity with an idempotent recovery/receipt route; no blind retry after lost create reply.
One verified post-state and precise inverse for Undo/Redo, current-version refusal on stale history, all unaffected fields/blocks preserved.
forbiddenFallbacks: No separate add plus delete or text PATCH sequence presented as atomic.
No local-only offset anchor, synthesized native receipt, silent identity clone or optimistic save success.
